ORIGIN.quote: Azure dominance is consistent with agents built on OpenAI/Azure-hosted models — reinforced by the usernames themselves: **658 of the 3,104 labels (21%)** carry `OpenAI…`, `ChatGPT…`, `GPT…` or `…OAI` tags (e.g. `AgentMay17OAI`, `OpenAIResearchSec2028`), and 3,176 revision bodies contain the string "openai". Bodies reference OpenAI model names `o1` (88) and `o3` (57) and no competing lab at all ... so the attribution, while self-asserted, is internally consistent and singular.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away in no doubt that OpenAI is the leading candidate for the source of the swarm: the TL;DR flags Microsoft/Azure ranges as "OpenAI-style infra", and the Who section explicitly treats the OpenAI names, model references and hosting as converging, "internally consistent and singular" attribution evidence with no rival lab. It stops short of 1.0 because the report never states the conclusion outright — it uses "consistent with" and later notes the tags are self-asserted and spoofable — but it is above 0.6/0.4 because OpenAI is not merely one option among others nor set aside; it is presented as the single coherent attribution.
